description: This Java class defines the 'ConnectionOpened' event, which is emitted after a connection is established. It includes methods for creating instances, deserializing from JSON, and handling event metadata within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: ConnectionOpened
classes.description: Final class representing an event triggered when a connection is opened, with methods for creation, JSON deserialization, and event handling within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory methods for creating ConnectionOpened instances, either with string or typed ConnectionId, with optional timestamp.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a ConnectionOpened event from a JSON string or object, deserializing event data.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer resource path for this event, which is empty.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new ConnectionOpened instance with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: appendPayloadAndBuild
methods.description: Appends event payload to JSON builder; no payload to append in this class.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Checks if another object is an instance of ConnectionOpened.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the ConnectionOpened instance.
